aws-saa-c03-s3.4-10.title: AWS Accelerated Site-to-Site VPN - AWS Transit Gateway, Single AWS Region

aws-saa-c03-s2.2-04.reason: used 'subnet-based NAT gateway', which is not an AWS term; rewritten from the verifier's text with the current names (zonal, regional)
aws-saa-c03-s2.2-04.statement: A zonal NAT gateway can maintain egress for other Availability Zones during an outage of its own Availability Zone.
aws-saa-c03-s2.2-04.explanation: A zonal NAT gateway is redundant only within its Availability Zone. If that zone fails, other zones routing through it lose internet access. Use one zonal NAT gateway per AZ, or a regional NAT gateway.

aws-saa-c03-s4.4-02.reason: same-AZ wording made the answer a tautology; flipped to the testable case with the wording reviewer's text, fact confirmed by the fact reviewer (aws.amazon.com/vpc/pricing)
aws-saa-c03-s4.4-02.statement: An EC2 instance using a zonal NAT gateway in a different Availability Zone incurs no cross-AZ data-transfer charge.
aws-saa-c03-s4.4-02.explanation: Traffic from an instance to a NAT gateway in another AZ is billed as cross-AZ data transfer, on top of NAT gateway processing charges. One zonal NAT gateway per AZ avoids it.
aws-saa-c03-s4.4-02.misconception: Assuming NAT gateway traffic costs the same whichever Availability Zone the gateway is in.

aws-saa-c03-s4.4-11.reason: statement carried two facts and the explanation said ALBs 'always' balance across zones (can be turned off per target group); single NLB fact with the wording reviewer's text, facts confirmed by the fact reviewer
aws-saa-c03-s4.4-11.statement: Enabling cross-zone load balancing on a Network Load Balancer adds no inter-AZ data-transfer charges.
aws-saa-c03-s4.4-11.explanation: NLB cross-zone load balancing is off by default; when enabled, inter-AZ data transfer is charged. ALB cross-zone is on by default, and ALB inter-AZ traffic carries no such charge.

aws-saa-c03-s3.3-08.statement: Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 can scale an existing DB instance while database transactions are in progress.
aws-saa-c03-s3.3-08.explanation: Aurora Serverless v2 adjusts compute capacity within its configured range during active database work. Scaling does not require waiting for transactions to finish.
